newsitem.title: UK: ICI marked higher after U.S. ADR strength.
newsitem.headline: ICI marked higher after U.S. ADR strength.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc were quoted higher in pre-market trading on Tuesday on the back of strength in its ADRs in New York overnight, dealers sadi.
ICI shares were marked up 9-1/2p at 707-1/2 by 0722 GMT in minimal volume of 274 shares, after its ADRs in New York closed $1/8 higher at $46-7/8.
"American strength has filtered over here this morning," said a senior sales trader at a top investment bank.
ICI shares, which have languished in recent months, on Monday touched a low of 686p -- near their three-year low of 679p set on April 4.
The stock fell sharply at the end of last month after analysts at HSBC James Capel and SBC Warburg lowered earnings estimates amid talk of continuing price pressures.
ICI reports first-quarter results on April 24.
